# A box's alignItems on bubbletea: a card's lines centered in its width, a
# row's short part centered down its tall one.
#
# bubbletea joined a column at its left and a row at its top whatever the
# style said, so a card's name sat at the card's left edge and the label
# beside a two-line block sat on its first line. The snapshot is the screen
# as text.
#
# Confirmed against the codegen before: `fig` at the start of its line and
# `beside` on the line of `one`.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=bubbletea app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'
# The card is 14 columns wide: `fig` sits 5 in, and `a long name` 1 in.
grep '(?m)^ {5}fig {6}$' app.sngl.snapshots/cards.ansi
grep '(?m)^ a long name {2}$' app.sngl.snapshots/cards.ansi
# `beside` is on the middle line of the three beside it.
grep '(?m)^one +$' app.sngl.snapshots/cards.ansi
grep '(?m)^two +beside *$' app.sngl.snapshots/cards.ansi

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

output { go { bubbletea } }

component cards ui.node {
    ui.vbox(style={gap=16px}) {
        ui.vbox(style={alignItems=center, width=112px}) {
            ui.text(value="fig")
            ui.text(value="a long name")
        }
        ui.hbox(style={alignItems=center, gap=8px}) {
            ui.vbox {
                ui.text(value="one")
                ui.text(value="two")
                ui.text(value="three")
            }
            ui.text(value="beside")
        }
    }
}

func testCards(t test.Test, c cards) {
    t.snapshot("cards")
}

ui.window {
    cards
}
-- testrun/bubbletea/go/app.sngl/cards/1 --
